hook.sub: for the people you love most

items.line: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
items.verse_ar: رَبَّنَا ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلۡحِسَابُ

items.line: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful.
items.verse_ar: رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدۡخِلۡنَا فِي رَحۡمَتِكَ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

items.line: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
items.verse_ar: رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنࣲ

items.line: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor… and make righteous for me my offspring.
My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
items.verse_ar: رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلۡ دُعَآءِ

items.line: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
items.verse_ar: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ

end.ask: Which one will you say tonight?
end.follow: Three lists a week. Follow for the next.

sources: Arabic: consecutive words checked identical in both quran/verse.py sources (A KFGQPC Hafs, B QuranEnc) on 27 Nov 2026; 3:38 dropped (sources differ). English: Saheeh International (fawazahmed0/quran-api edition eng-ummmuhammad), verbatim; 46:15 shortened with an ellipsis. Speakers: 14:35 (Abraham), 71:26 (Noah), 7:151 [Moses] in Saheeh.
